caseNameFull: MacNEIL v. MORTON, JUSTICES OF THE SUPERIOR COURT
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Edward' J. McCormack, Jr., Attorney General of Massachusetts, and Richard H. Gens and William F. Long, Jr., Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal.is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
